lead: Silloo Manekshaw was an Indian military officer, born on 3 April 1914 in Amritsar.
He died on 27 June 2008 in Wellington at the age of 94.
He has held the office of Chief of the Army Staff and Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee and has been recognised with Military Cross and Padma Bhushan.
The sections that follow break down Silloo Manekshaw's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

paras: Silloo Manekshaw was born on 3 April 1914 in Amritsar, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India.

sections.heading: Silloo Manekshaw — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists military officer as his main occupation.
He has held the following offices: Chief of the Army Staff (1969–1973) and Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee (1970–1973).
He has taken part in Bangladesh Liberation War.
